units.source_text: 因此，我的体验里没有重叠的东西。

en.t: Therefore, there was nothing overlapping in my experiences.

units.source_text: 没有类似重叠形成的地层。

en.t: There were no strata formed by anything like accumulation.

units.source_text: 没有类似制造山形的厚重。

en.t: There was no heaviness of the kind that shapes a mountain.

units.source_text: 除了金阁，对所有事物都没有亲近感的我，

en.t: I, who felt no intimacy with anything except the Golden Pavilion,

units.source_text: 就是对待自己的体验也不抱有特别的亲近感。

en.t: felt no special intimacy even toward my own experiences.

units.source_text: 我只知道在这些体验里，没有被黑暗时间的海洋完全吞噬的部分，

en.t: All I knew was that within these experiences there were no parts completely swallowed by the dark ocean of time,

units.source_text: 没有陷入毫无意义的漫无边际的重复的部分，

en.t: no parts that had sunk into meaningless, boundless repetition,

units.source_text: 而正在逐步形成由这样小部分的连锁组成的一种可恶的不吉利的图景。

en.t: but a hateful and ominous pattern, made from a chain of such small parts, was gradually taking shape.
